name: Jamshid Pazhouyan
detail: Prominent economist and longtime proponent of comprehensive wealth tax in Iran; passed away in July 2020.

name: Mohsen Renani
detail: Institutional economist whose commentary focuses on oil rent, tax culture, and political economy rather than a net wealth tax.

name: Masoud Nili
detail: Economist focusing on personal income tax, macroeconomic stabilization, and consumption tax rather than a wealth tax.

name: Mohammad Reza Pour-Ebrahimi
detail: Former Chairman of Majlis Economic Commission who focused strictly on capital gains tax (CGT) on real estate and explicitly opposed bank deposit or equity wealth taxation.

name: Mehdi Movahedi Bek-Nazar
detail: Tax administration spokesperson who clarified that annual luxury house and luxury car taxes are single-asset luxury excise levies, not aggregate net wealth taxes.

name: Hossein Samsami
detail: MP and economist whose tax proposals center on anti-speculation CGT in currency, gold, and real estate, not a tax on stock of net wealth.

name: Farshad Momeni
detail: Institutional economist who frequently critiques tax exemptions for wealthy entities in annual budget bills, but advocates general taxation of wealthy corporations rather than an explicit net wealth tax.

name: Ali Dini Torkamani
detail: Economist critiquing regressive VAT and structural tax exemptions without formulating a specific net wealth tax platform.

name: Alireza Mahjoub
detail: Worker House Secretary General and former MP whose advocacy centers on labor wages, PIT thresholds, and anti-speculation CGT rather than net wealth tax.

name: Ahmad Meydari
detail: Economist and former Deputy Minister whose work focuses on the Iranian Welfare Database and targeted cash transfers rather than enacting a wealth tax.

name: Mehdi Sarmast
detail: Parliamentary analyst at Majlis Research Center who argued in December 2022 that calculating net wealth is too complex and urged prioritizing CGT and PIT over a wealth tax.

name: Mostafa Jafari Parvar
detail: Supreme Council of Taxation expert who argued in December 2022 that wealth taxation should be postponed until PIT and vacant homes taxes are implemented.

name: Gholamreza Tajgardoon
detail: Longtime Chairman of Majlis Plan and Budget Commission who focused on budget balancing and cautioned against broad wealth taxation.

name: Omid-Ali Parsa
detail: Former Head of the State Tax Administration who championed the 2020 Direct Taxes reform focusing on PIT, CGT, and luxury home/car excises rather than net wealth tax.

name: Saeed Laylaz
detail: Prominent macroeconomist who argued for the fiscal necessity of general taxation replacing oil revenues and issuing debt, without proposing a net wealth tax.

name: Hadi Ghavami
detail: MP and economist who focused on anti-speculation CGT and energy subsidy adjustments rather than a wealth tax.

name: Ahmad Tavakkoli
detail: Anti-corruption campaigner and former MP whose advocacy centers on banking transparency, anti-rent measures, and CGT rather than net wealth taxation.

name: Abbas Shakeri
detail: Allameh Tabataba'i University professor who researched inheritance tax and monetary policy without proposing a net wealth tax.

name: Faramarz Tofighi
detail: Labor activist and former wage committee chair who focuses on the subsistence basket and poverty line rather than wealth tax legislation.

name: Ali Khodaei
detail: Labor member of the Supreme Labour Council whose tax commentary focuses on raising personal income tax exemption thresholds for workers.

name: Hassan Sadeghi
detail: Veteran Workers Union head who critiques budget pressures on workers and general corporate tax evasion without formulating a net wealth tax.

name: Davood Manzoor
detail: Former INTA and PBO head who classifies conveyance, inheritance, and luxury car/home excises as wealth tax rather than an aggregate net wealth tax.

name: Mohammad Hadi Sobhanian
detail: Head of INTA who implements single-property luxury house and luxury car excise levies under annual budget laws.

name: Lotfali Agheli
detail: Tarbiat Modares University economist whose work focuses on zakat capacity and macroeconomic private consumption wealth effects.
